reference.kernels: pure-PyTorch reference paths (no kernels hub, fla or causal-conv1d installed)

messages.content: Briefly, in two sentences: why does the sky look blue during the day but red at sunset?

prompt.rendered: [gMASK]<sop><|system|>Reasoning Effort: Max<|user|>Briefly, in two sentences: why does the sky look blue during the day but red at sunset?<|assistant|><think>
prompt.decode_text: Sunlight scatters off air molecules, and blue light scatters more

notes.dtype_policy: fp32: FP8 weights dequantised with transformers' Fp8Dequantize to FP32, BF16/F32 tensors upcast; every parameter and activation FP32 on CPU
notes.prefill: the whole prompt in one forward (KDA uses the reference's chunked path)
notes.decode: one token per forward with the reference cache, continuing from the prompt (KDA recurrent path); decode.<name> tensors are stacked over steps, decode.sN.<name> are per step. The state before step 0 is in the matching -prefill set.
notes.index_layout: idx.topk rows hold min(512, pools) selected pools x 4 tokens in descending score order (tokens of pools not yet complete or visible are -1), then the tail slots (index_kpool - 1 = 3, -1 where unused), then -1 padding to 2051
notes.variant: k16.*: the same attention module and weights with index_topk=16 (4 pools + tail), fed prefill/decode attn_norm; not the model's configuration

decode.in_streams.desc: decoder layer input: the 4 mHC residual streams [tokens, hc, hidden] [steps, ...]

decode.attn_hc.pre.desc: attention-site mHC pre weights (sigmoid + eps) that collapse the streams [steps, ...]

decode.attn_hc.post.desc: attention-site mHC post weights (2*sigmoid) that expand the block output [steps, ...]

decode.attn_hc.comb.desc: attention-site mHC comb matrix after Sinkhorn; new_stream[i] = sum_j comb[j,i]*stream[j] + post[i]*block_out [steps, ...]

decode.attn_hc.collapsed.desc: attention-site collapsed input sum_i pre[i]*stream[i] (before input_layernorm) [steps, ...]

decode.mla.q_resid.desc: q_a_layernorm(q_a_proj(x)): MLA query latent, also the indexer's query input [steps, ...]

decode.mla.latent.desc: kv_a_layernorm output: the 512-dim MLA latent that the KV cache holds per token [steps, ...]
